sections.title: Two everyday uses of tud
sections.content: tud means "to know [a language]" when followed directly by an -ul/-ül word, and "can, to be able to" when followed by an infinitive — two uses of the same verb that come up constantly in a language-learning conversation.

items.spanish: Tudok magyarul, de nem tudok jól beszélni.
items.english: I know Hungarian, but I can't speak well.

sections.content: tud's full system, alongside lehet and szabad, is coming in a later unit. For now these two everyday uses are enough: tudok + language = "I know [language]"; tudok + infinitive = "I can do X."
